arxiv-1811-06966.title: Temporal Grounding Graphs for Language Understanding with Accrued Visual-Linguistic Context
arxiv-1811-06966.creator: Rohan Paul and Andrei Barbu and Sue Felshin and Boris Katz and Nicholas Roy
arxiv-1811-06966.description: Abstract A robot’s ability to understand or ground natural language instructions is fundamentally tied to its knowledge about the surrounding world. We present an approach to grounding natural language utterances in the context of factual information gathered through natural-language interactions and past visual observations.

arxiv-2012-13728.title: Requirements of API Documentation: A Case Study into Computer Vision Services
arxiv-2012-13728.creator: Alex Cummaudo, Rajesh Vasa, John Grundy, Mohamed Abdelrazek
arxiv-2012-13728.description: Abstract Using cloud-based computer vision services is gaining traction, where developers access AI-powered components through familiar RESTful APIs, not needing to orchestrate large training and inference infrastructures or curate/label training datasets. However, while these APIs seem familiar to use, their non-deterministic run-time behaviour and evolution is not adequately communicated to developers.

arxiv-2102-00890.title: Mn Dimer can be Described Accurately with Density Functional Calculations when Self-interaction Correction is Applied
arxiv-2102-00890.creator: Aleksei V. Ivanov, Tushar K. Ghosh, Elvar Ö. Jónsson, Hannes Jónsson
arxiv-2102-00890.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Aleksei V. Ivanov, Tushar K. Ghosh, Elvar Ö. Jónsson, Hannes Jónsson. Qualitatively incorrect results are obtained for the Mn dimer in density functional theory calculations using the generalized gradient approximation (GGA) and similar results are obtained from local density and meta-GGA functionals. The coupling is predicted to be ferromagnetic rather than antiferromagnetic and the bond between the atoms is predicted to be an order of magnitude too strong and about an Ångstrøm too short.

arxiv-2212-14554.title: Active Planning for Cooperative Localization: A Fisher Information Approach
arxiv-2212-14554.creator: Wenyu Zhang 1, Bryan Teague 2, Florian Meyer 1
arxiv-2212-14554.description: Abstract Location-aware networks will introduce new services and applications for modern convenience, surveillance, and public safety. In this paper, we consider the problem of cooperative localization in a wireless network where the position of certain anchor nodes can be controlled.

arxiv-2410-06395.title: Multimodal Representation Learning using Adaptive Graph Construction
arxiv-2410-06395.creator: Weichen Huang
arxiv-2410-06395.description: Abstract Multimodal contrastive learning train neural networks by levergaing data from heterogeneous sources such as images and text. Yet, many current multimodal learning architectures cannot generalize to an arbitrary number of modalities and need to be hand-constructed. We propose AutoBIND, a novel contrastive learning framework that can learn representations from an arbitrary number of modalites through graph optimization.

arxiv-2511-21327.title: The Theory of Storage in a Power System with Stochastic Demand
arxiv-2511-21327.creator: Darryl Biggar, Mohammad Reza Hesamzadeh
arxiv-2511-21327.description: Abstract Electric power systems are increasingly turning to energy storage systems to balance supply and demand. But how much storage is required? What is the optimal volume of storage in a power system and on what does it depend? In addition, what form of hedge contracts do storage facilities require?

arxiv-2601-04890.title: Maksim Velikanov
arxiv-2601-04890.description: Abstract Applying weight decay (WD) to matrix layers is standard practice in large-language-model pretraining. Prior work suggests that stochastic gradient noise induces a Brownian-like expansion of the weight matrices W W , whose growth is counteracted by WD, leading to a WD-noise equilibrium with a certain weight norm ‖ W ‖ \|W\| .

britannica-1911-cedar.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-cedar.description: Article 'Cedar' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 5), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Cedrus Libani, the far-famed Cedar of Lebanon, is a tree which, on account of its beauty, stateliness and strength, has always been a favourite with poets and painters, and which, in the figurative language of prophecy, is frequently employed in the Scriptures as a symbol of power, prosperity and longevity.

pmc-12473130.title: Understanding the Magnetic Exchange Pathways of Transition-Metal-Doped Monolayer TiS2 Using First-Principles Calculations
pmc-12473130.creator: P. J. Keeney, P. M. Coelho, J. T. Haraldsen
pmc-12473130.description: The ideal crystal symmetry of the 1T-TiS2 lattice results in a non-magnetic structure. However, recent studies have demonstrated that it may become magnetic upon substitution with transition-metal (TM) atoms. In this study, we examine the mechanisms and interactions that allow magnetic exchange through the TiS2 matrix.

pmc-12559818.title: Anti-VEGF Treatment for Bilateral Choroidal Neovascularization Secondary to Laser Pointer Injury in a Child: Case Report
pmc-12559818.creator: Sena Esra Günay, Sezin Akça Bayar, Gülşah Gökgöz, Gürsel Yılmaz
pmc-12559818.description: s a 7-year-old patient with bilateral laser-maculopathy who showed rapid progression of type 2 choroidal neovascularization (CNV) in the right eye (RE) and suspected CNV in the left eye (LE) after accidental exposure to a class 3R handheld laser pointer. This case emphasizes the importance of recognizing the development of choroidal vascularization following laser pointer-induced maculopathy.

pmc-12693761.title: Design of a Verification Device of Motor Axle Wheel Load Scales Based on Pump-Controlled Hydraulic Cylinder
pmc-12693761.creator: Long Hao, Zhipeng Xu, Bin Zhou, Gaoming Zhang, Zheng Chen
pmc-12693761.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Vehicle axle load scales are one of the most important devices for vehicle safety testing. To ensure the stability and reliability of test results, regular calibration of axle load scales is necessary. Traditional calibration methods are inefficient and error-prone. In this work, an automatic calibration device for portable axle load scales was presented, which uses a pump-controlled hydraulic cylinder as a loading unit. The loading unit was controlled by a high-precision force sensor and a PLC.

pmc-12987879.title: Selecting the optimal MIC for five patient-reported outcome measures in patients with upper extremity injuries, using a systematic search and step-by-step decision tree
pmc-12987879.creator: S. G. J. Suus van Bruggen, F. L. Floortje Opperman, E. P. Ilse Jansma, C. M. Charlotte Lameijer, F. W. Frank Bloemers, C. B. Caroline Terwee
pmc-12987879.description: PurposeTo illustrate how optimal MIC values can be selected for PROMs using a systematic step-by-step approach.MethodsA systematic search was performed in PubMed, Embase and Cochrane, until June 2024 to identify all studies that estimated the MIC for the following PROMs in patients with upper extremity injuries: DASH, Q-DASH, MHQ, PRWE and PROMIS-UE.

pmc-13076460.title: Education of Residents Improves Frequency and Alignment of Evidence-Based Lifestyle Interventions
pmc-13076460.creator: Scott Moore, Ashley Riley, Cassadi Forman, Jacob Henington, Kaitlyn Draper, Nolan Barker, Mary Ying-Fang Wang, Brian Degenhardt
pmc-13076460.description: The United States spends more on health care than any other nation, yet hundreds of thousands of Americans die each year from conditions that could be prevented through basic lifestyle changes. Although about 80% of premature deaths are linked to unhealthy behaviors, Lifestyle Medicine (LM) receives little emphasis in most medical school and residency curricula.

pmc-13145407.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026YS75 SUBGROUP-SPECIFIC PERFORMANCE OF OUTCOME PREDICTION MODELS AFTER ENDOVASCULAR THERAPY FOR ACUTE ISCHEMIC STROKE: AN EVA-TRISP REGISTRY STUDY
pmc-13145407.creator: Lukas Enz, Marcel Arnold, Katarina Jood, Susanne Wegener, Patrik Michel, Sami Curtze, Christian Nolte, Gian Marco De Marchis, Paul Nederkoorn, Henrik Gensicke
pmc-13145407.description: Background and aimsNumerous prognostic models predict functional outcome after acute ischemic stroke, yet their performance in clinically relevant patient subgroups remains poorly characterized. Recent TRIPOD and PROBAST guidance emphasizes subgroup validation to identify bias and inequities. We externally validated established stroke outcome prediction models and assessed their subgroup performance after endovascular therapy (EVT).

pmc-13221369.title: Management-specific outcome evaluation of pituitary apoplexy; conservative and surgical approach
pmc-13221369.creator: M C Guijt, M JT Verstegen, A H Zamanipoor Najafabadi, L EH Bakker, I C Notting, I CM Pelsma, W R van Furth, N R Biermasz, K MJA Claessen
pmc-13221369.description: PurposePituitary apoplexy can be managed by early surgery or a conservative approach, if necessary, followed by later elective surgery. Choice of management is related to correct diagnosis, symptom severity at presentation and symptom development prior to contacting the pituitary center of excellence (PTCOE). Specific circumstances may dictate a specific choice, in others shared decision-making is key.

pmc-13377398.creator: Cheng-Wei Huang, Dan N. Huynh, Bing Han, Janet S. Lee, Ming-Sum Lee, Alyssa T. Millan, Kiet V. Lieu, Romina S. Rosen, Mehran R. Sina, Christopher C. Subject, Khang A. Nguyen, Huong Q. Nguyen

pmc-13382071.title: Maxillary and Cervical En Bloc Resection With Consideration of the Lymphatic Flow Pathway for Maxillary Gingival Carcinoma: A Case Report
pmc-13382071.creator: Y Kondo, K Kawahara, R Nakamura, Y Tange, M Ando, Hannah Wesley
pmc-13382071.description: En bloc resection of the primary tumor along with the cervical lymphatic tissue is not commonly performed in patients with maxillary gingival carcinoma because of the physical distance between the primary lesion and cervical metastatic site. However, delayed metastases to lymph nodes outside the standard dissection range, such as the buccinator lymph nodes, may adversely affect the prognosis.

pmc-13629387.title: Composite and Blends of PFD and MEH-PPV Conjugated Polymer Nanoparticles: Combined Optical Properties and Quantum Yield Increase by FRET
pmc-13629387.creator: Caio Henrique Viana da Silva, Milton Lopes de Lana Junior, Thiago Cazati, Mariana P. Brandao, Andreza Germana da Silva Subtil
pmc-13629387.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Conjugated Polymer Nanoparticles (CPNs) exhibit photophysical properties that depend strongly on morphology, chain conformations, solvent conditions, synthesis processes, the polymer chain’s length and distribution, and interchain/intrachain interactions. The production of CPNs using combinations of two different conjugated polymers can be used to create nanocomposites, by mixing previously formed CPNs from distinct polymers, and to create blend CPNs, by mixing distinct polymers prior to the formation of the CPNs.

pmc-13679290.title: Botulinum toxin type A for myogenic temporomandibular disorders: A scoping review of injection protocols, clinical outcomes, safety, and evidence gaps
pmc-13679290.creator: Marines Vega Sanchez, Luis Chauca Bajaña, Francisco Córdova, Maria Rodriguez Tates, Byron Velasquez Ron
pmc-13679290.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundBotulinum toxin type A (BoNT-A) has been increasingly investigated for persistent myogenic temporomandibular disorders (TMDs), particularly when conservative therapies provide insufficient symptom control. However, variability in patient selection, injection protocols, outcomes, and safety reporting complicates interpretation of its effectiveness.ObjectiveTo map and critically synthesize evidence regarding BoNT-A injection protocols, clinical outcomes, functional and physiological effects, safety, and methodological limitations in adults with myogenic TMD.MethodsThis scoping review followed PRISMA-ScR.
